address: 358 West Yan'an Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Open until 2am, this restaurant specialising in regional dishes from the Cantonese city of Zhanjiang is a popular choice for a late-night supper. Free-range chicken shipped from the city is steamed or deep-fried for juicy flesh and intense flavour. The pan-fried white pomfret packs an umami punch and brings briny sweetness. Chinese mugwort cake is a rustic snack stuffed with a savoury or sweet filling then steamed. Pre-order dishes to avoid disappointment....
